sections.excerpt:

to us will be approximately $5,757,239, after deducting the estimated placement agent fees and expected offering expenses payable by
us, and none of the Warrants issued in this offering are exercised. Even if the Warrants are exercised, we do not expect to receive any

sections.title: Dilution
sections.excerpt:
DILUTION Investors purchasing our Class A Ordinary
Shares in this offering will not experience dilution in the pro forma as adjusted net tangible book value of their Class A Ordinary Shares,
because the assumed public offering price in this offering is below our historical net tangible book value per ordinary share. Instead,
our existing shareholders will experience an immediate decrease in the pro forma as adjusted net tangible book value per share of their
ordinary shares, and investors purchasing our Class A Ordinary Shares in this offering will acquire them at a price below that net tangible
book value per share. Dilution or accretion in pro forma as adjusted net tangible book value represents the difference between the public
